notes.title: Patch 1.1: Buffs, Custom Keybinds, and future patches!
notes.content:
The game's first patch will include some much needed buffs to the player, so that things won't be so hard anymore, but nonetheless is still very challenging. These buffs include a movement speed increase and some cooldown changes. 

You will now also be able to change your keybindings from the main menu, and from the pause screen.

Along will these updates the player has undergone a slight makeover to improve the overall look. Graphics quality can now be changed, helping the game run on very low end systems.

[h2]Future Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller Support
[*] Cloud Saves
[*] Online highscore leaderboards
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list]
